newsitem.title: UK: NatWest extends loss on negative comment.
newsitem.headline: NatWest extends loss on negative comment.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc shares dropped to their lowest level in a month on Wednesday amid negative press comment on the group's first-half results, released on Tuesday.

The shares were down 7p at 828 by 0820 GMT, extending Tuesday's 35p loss after the bank reported profits hit by a slump in its investment banking earnings and ruled out major acquisitions or a merger.

The Financial Times Lex column noted that NatWest had not reduced its cost/income ratio in UK banking while rivals had made substantial cuts, adding that its heavy exposure to small business lending could make NatWest vulnerable as the economy slowed in 1998.
